title: When Denoising Hurts: Rethinking the Terminal Step of Diffusion Time Series Forecasters -- Extended Version
abstract: arXiv:2608.14067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models offer a natural way to model uncertainty in time series forecasting, yet their iterative sampling process is often treated as a uniformly beneficial refinement procedure. Our study challenges this view by examining how forecast quality evolves throughout reverse diffusion. We find that general temporal structure is often recovered at relatively high noise levels, whereas continued low-noise refinement can introduce statistical drift and degrade the final forecast. Our analysis further suggests that this behavior explains why prior methods often favor relatively narrow diffusion architecture and schedule design. Building on this observation, we propose a label-free global stopping criterion that detects the optimal termination point, eventually speeding up inference and improving predictive accuracy. translated_title: 当去噪有害时：重新思考扩散时间序列预测器的终端步骤 -- 扩展版
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14067v1 公告类型：新 摘要：扩散模型为时间序列预测中的不确定性建模提供了一种自然方式，然而其迭代采样过程通常被视为一种统一有益的细化程序。我们的研究通过考察预测质量在反向扩散过程中如何演变来挑战这一观点。我们发现，一般的时间结构通常在高噪声水平下即可恢复，而持续的低噪声细化可能引入统计漂移并降低最终预测性能。我们的分析进一步表明，这一行为解释了为何先前方法往往偏好相对狭窄的扩散架构和调度设计。基于这一观察，我们提出了一种无标签的全局停止准则，用于检测最佳终止点，最终加速推理并提高预测准确性。此外，由于早期停止会在高噪声区域终止推理，我们提出了一种伯努利时间步采样器，以优化此场景下的采样过程。
tldr: 本文发现扩散时间序列预测中过度去噪会引入统计漂移并损害性能，提出了一种无标签全局停止准则和伯努利时间步采样器，以在最佳点终止推理，加速推断并提升预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that over-denoising in diffusion time series forecasting introduces statistical drift and harms performance, proposing a label-free global stopping criterion and a Bernoulli timestep sampler to terminate inference at the optimal point, accelerating inference and improving prediction accuracy.
